title: Normalized representation of an integer multiplicity current (supplied step 1)
statement: Assume (VO), (MR) and (IMC). (VO) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and test forms ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. (MR) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open, an IMRep R in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and every open W, M_W(T) = T.massOn W = R.measure W. (IMC) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, the conjunction of: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U ⊆ ℝ^P open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q; (b) restriction: for U open, an IMRep R in U and a Borel set E there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult, R'.orient = R.orient; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity if A, B are (U open); (d) for every IMRep R, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ R.carrier and every n-covector α, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and X ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) integer multiplicity. Then there is an IMRep R in U with R.Represents X, R.carrier ⊆ spt X (X.support) and R.measure(U) = M(X) (X.mass).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support ∧ R.measure U = X.mass
